meaning: One list of every strategy that holds or held paper money, with its status and verdict. Madhav, Oct 13: the $500 NDAX book is THE account (what he and Ananta look at); the engine keeps every measuring book running in the background (watching, scanning, recording, tracking), and only what passes its bar is pushed into the account. status: ACTIVE (trades, counts as holdings) | UNDER_REVIEW (trades, counts, under a review) | EVIDENCE (measures in the background: records paper trades, never holdings, never in the headline) | PARKED (switched off by Madhav) | RETIRED (takes no new trades; its record is kept). verdict: wont_take_again | will_try_again | modify_rules. wakes_brain: false = its signals never wake the brain (a failed idea is recorded, not decided on). pushed: how a strategy enters the account.
pushed: A rule enters the $500 book's measured-edge sleeve when BOTH hold: its cell (rule x dial state x tier) passed on history in both periods after costs (the measured-edge table, review #26), AND its forward paper book is ahead of its random baseline over 10 market days in each regime (the promotion ladder), with Madhav's sign-off. When the ladder says a rule may step up, Ananta sends a phone note and opens a request; nothing enters the account by itself.

BOOK500.name: The $500 NDAX book
BOOK500.why: The account: core by the dial (BTC 40%, ETH 20%), the measured edges (today: H07 on tier A while the dial is closed), a judgment sleeve for the brain's buys, the D12 brakes. Started Oct 11 at NDAX's real prices.

T3.name: Trend portfolio (10 coins)
T3.why: Passed both periods on history on the liquid top-30 tier; on all 120 it only cut losses, and the 10-coin-era pass is legacy lab, not evidence (Oct 14 audit). On the 10 most-traded coins as they really were each month it passes both periods but much weaker: +3.7% in 2024-26 vs +15.1% on today's 10, holding lost 31.9% (review #30). A trend book loses in a sideways chop (Oct 4-13) and that cost is known. Measured forward against the $500 book's core, which carries the same idea with the dial.

T3_T30.name: 30-coin trend book
T3_T30.why: Evidence only, never a candidate for real money (Madhav, Oct 15): it fails the survivorship test on the 30 (review #22). Keeps measuring in the background as evidence.

H07.name: Short dip trade (H07)
H07.why: The one measured edge (review #26: tier A while the dial is closed, +5.1% a trade over random, both periods; review #29 confirmed it point-in-time on all 530 Binance pairs with live costs, +6.3% a trade expected). Its live paper record is read from the database: {closed} closed, {won} won ({net}); the scoreboard counts independent market events, not trades (Evidence page). It feeds the $500 book's edge sleeve; tiers B/C and the 30-coin version keep measuring.

JARVIS.name: The brain's own $100 book
JARVIS.why: How the brain is measured against its random twin (live paper record: {closed} closed, {won} won, {net}; the twin comparison is on the Jarvis page). It records in the background; the brain's buys reach the account only through the $500 book's judgment sleeve (at most 10%). Rules changed Oct 11 (reviews #27, #28, D7); judged again after 20 closed trades under the new rules.

BOLD.name: The bold book: the brain's one idea a day, taken whenever the dial is open
BOLD.why: A registered experiment (fix A8, approved by Madhav Oct 15): does the brain's judgment add anything when it must act? $100 of paper a day on dial-open days against a random tier-A twin (RANDOM_BOLD), under docs/knowledge/bold_mandate.json. Expected to lose at first at measured costs; reviewed after 30 closed trades or 60 days, whichever is later. Never the account.

ZONE_TOUCH.name: Daily zone touch
ZONE_TOUCH.why: A plain touch of a zone is not a reason to buy: it lost with every exit on 8 years of data (review #27) and, live, {lost} of {closed} closed paper trades lost ({lost_usd}). It keeps recording in the background as the yardstick for zones, never wakes the brain, and will not be pushed.

EXPLORER.name: 15-minute Explorer (E1-E8)
EXPLORER.why: No intraday setup has an edge after costs (reviews #1, #3, #24; 0 of 55 atlas contexts). Live paper record: {closed} closed, {won} won ({net}). It keeps scanning as the intraday eyes and recording its paper book as evidence (Q1 live-vs-replay); it never wakes the brain and will not be pushed.

HOURLY.name: Hourly watch (Hunter, Squeeze)
HOURLY.why: Parked by Madhav (D6, Oct 11); neither Hunter nor Squeeze showed an edge.

CANDIDATE.name: Frozen trend-dip candidate books (V0 and V1)
CANDIDATE.why: The 4-hour trend-dip candidate failed its one-time holdout (docs/research/CANDIDATE_V3_HOLDOUT_RESULT.md: -0.48% a trade at NDAX costs, its $1,000 book -2.94% while buy-and-hold made +24.69%); V1, its trend-ride exit, passed the fresh-coin study by its rules but lost 61% from a 2025 start (docs/research/STUDY_V3_FRESH_RESULTS.md). Both paper books (candidate_book.sqlite V0, candidate_v1_book.sqlite V1) ran inside the hourly watch: last trades closed Oct 8 (V0 3, V1 10, none won), no updates since that watch was parked on Oct 11 (D6). Kept as a record; never the account, never pushed.

READS.name: Madhav's setups M1-M3 (universe books)
READS.why: Measured forward per tier against random; no measured edge yet (reviews #5, #26). Pushed only if a cell passes and the ladder agrees.

RANDOM.name: Random baselines
RANDOM.why: The yardstick every book is measured against (10-, 20- and 30-day twins per tier). Never holdings. Live: {closed} closed twin trades, {won} won ({net}); every 'vs random' verdict waits for independent market events, not trades.

MANUAL.name: Madhav's own trades
MANUAL.why: His own paper trades, stamped with his initials; not a strategy Ananta judges.

evidence_window.rule: No real money before 60 market days of paper operation, both market-dial states seen, and execution within 3 points of the backtest (Rule A). No new crypto strategies meanwhile (Rule B). Madhav, Oct 14.
